tag.name: Meta Event - Lead - GHL Form Submit

parameter.value:
<script>
  // Fire Meta Pixel Lead event with advanced matching from GHL form submit.
  // Re-init scopes the user data to this event, then track sends it.
  fbq('init', '{{Meta Pixel ID}}', {
    em: {{cJS - GHL Email (Normalized)}},
    ph: {{cJS - GHL Phone (E.164)}},
    fn: {{DLV - GHL First Name}},
    ln: {{DLV - GHL Last Name}}
  });

  fbq('track', 'Lead', {
    content_name: 'GHL Form Submit',
    content_category: 'Lead',
    lead_type: 'ghl_form_submit',
    form_id: {{DLV - GHL Form ID}},
    ad_placement: {{cJS - Placement}},
    traffic_source: {{cJS - Traffic Source}}
  }, {
    eventID: {{DLV - GHL Event ID}}
  });
</script>
